notes: Food can spoil.
Loot is better the further you get from the starting valley.
Three hidden places with very rare loot.
Zombies no longer appear in front of you.
Walls and doors muffle noise for zombies.
Killed zombies stay dead for a long time.
Zombies have voices (placeholders for now).
Forests grow in clumps with clearings, and ferns grow on the forest floor.
Buildings and mountains stay visible from far away.
Five backup copies of your world save.
Forest sounds, and echo and muffling indoors. New setting: Ambience volume.
You hear your breathing and heartbeat. New setting: Heartbeat and breathing sounds.
Axes and pickaxes sound different on trees and rocks.
Zombie voices are placeholders, and the new sounds are not balanced yet.
Far hills look bare, and ferns are thin.
Some furniture near the Lundford start floats, and one village car sits too low.

notes: Drink from lakes and rivers, and fill bottles.
Dirty water can make you ill.
Antibiotics.
When you die, your things lie in a bag where you fell.
Zombies find their way round fences, hedges and houses.
Lit rooms draw zombies at night.
Zombies can no longer bite through walls, doors or windows.
Zombie bites make a sound.
Windows in the village houses open and close.
A locked front door can be opened from inside.
Stepping outside no longer leaves the street dark.
Every item has a picture, and clothing goes on with a double-click.
Weapons no longer wear down on blows that do nothing.
The world saves when a player leaves or dies.
Without Steam you keep the same survivor from one launch to the next.
Fixed floating plates and food, and a few smaller house and sound problems.
Zombies cannot vault hedges or cross rivers yet.
Water and illness are not tuned yet.

notes: Haldersfield looks Nordic and lived in.
The houses are furnished, and each one shows how its people left.
Working lights, and switches by the doors.
Some houses have zombies inside.
Doors can be open, locked or barricaded.
Bags lie out in the world to search.
Notes and letters tell the story of Vintermark.
Snow on roofs, cars and the ground, and falling snow.
New worlds begin in autumn.
Stamina: a sprint runs out.
Zombies run faster, look different from each other and stay dead.
A torch gives you away to zombies at night.
Houses keep you warmer.
Difficulty changes more than the zombie count.
Co-op checks for cheating players.
A setting to send anonymous statistics.
Items have descriptions.
Smoother frame rate and a cleaner look indoors.
A smaller download.
Fixed: the clock reset when you loaded a world.
Fixed: searched cupboards could refill.
Fixed: house doors reset when you walked away.
Fixed: two players could take the same item.
Fixed: stalls when loading a world, and the snap-back after a sprint in co-op.
Some attic rooms are very dark at dusk.
One house may have gaps in its upper floor.
Difficulty is only partly in place.
The cheat check is untested with lag.
The statistics notice is only in Settings.
